svg.text: Controller Pico (bottom of the staff) — breadboard wiring
Pico → 74AHCT125 → WS2812 strip; encoder and buttons to GND (internal pull-ups); LIS3DH on I2C0; microSD direct at 3.3 V. Pin numbers = physical pins.
folded in the tube, both ends at the bottom
Short piece of strip is fine for the first test.
Feed +5V/GND at both ends in the staff.
A, B, push; C pin = GND),
short leads, right at the part
• All GND flags are one net: power bank GND, strip, 74AHCT125, Pico GND.
• Pico powered from +5V only through D1 (1N5819, stripe towards VSYS), never directly.
• Decoupling capacitors C1, C2: see above right; C3 1000 µF at the strip.
• Strip full white (~5 A) exceeds the power bank; the firmware limits to ~2.6 A.
